name: Instant Hot Water Tap Digital Display
description:
Instant Hot Water Tap Digital Display  
Easy to fitting sink and tap both
Save Electricity
Easy to Install
Hot and normal water both are possible as per your requirement
Dimensions: 48x16x25cm
It will be used in the Kitchen sink and bathroom tap and basin
Temperature: 30 - 60° C
Voltage: 220V
Watt: 3000+
